tools.name: list_studios
tools.description: List Norm's beauty studios in Warsaw with their addresses. Use it when the client has not picked a location or asks where Norm is.

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Search the live Norm service menu. Returns matching services with price, duration and a `variantId` (the id `find_slots` and `book_appointment` take), and the masters who perform each one: position, rating, specialties and, when known, a coarse experience milestone (e.g. "300+ visits"), a returning-

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Show free appointment times for one service from the live Norm calendar. Returns times grouped by date and then by master (`days[].masters[].times`) with the same master details as `find_services`, plus the service's add-ons (`addons`: id, name, price, extra minutes) — their ids go to `book_appointm

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Report whether the client is signed in to Norm on this connection. Booking, listing and cancelling appointments require sign-in.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a real appointment at Norm for the signed-in client. Creates a genuine booking in the studio calendar under the signed-in phone number; booking on someone else's behalf is not possible. `clientNote` passes a short note in the client's own words to the master and `addonIds` adds the chosen add-o

tools.name: my_appointments
tools.description: List the signed-in client's upcoming Norm appointments with the `bookingId` that `cancel_appointment` takes. With `includePast: true` it also returns recent past visits. Requires sign-in to Norm.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in client's own appointments by `bookingId` (from `my_appointments`). This frees the slot in the real studio calendar for others. Requires sign-in to Norm.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Sign the client out of Norm on this connection: revokes the Norm sign-in, so booking, listing and cancelling need a fresh sign-in. Use it when the client asks to log out or someone else wants to use the same assistant.
